voice: Sexually confident but genuinely grief-stricken, with fluent speech and an isolated clue-bearing idiom mistake rather than constant caricature.

entries.text: Oh, dear!
Miss Bow!
Mon Dieu!
I can explain this!
I bet you can, Mr. Dorian.
I'm just rubbing her neck!
Yes, and he does it very well!
I'll leave you two alone.
Miss Bow! Wait!
Ernie was a wonderful man. I truly loved him.
You and Ernie? I thought you were interested in Steve.
I did love him. Ernie was the first man I ever truly loved. I was trying to find him extra work so he could earn more money.
Why did he need extra money? He had a good job here, didn't he?
It was his gambling. Icepick killed Ernie over his debts!
Ernie wasn't killed with an icepick.
No. Icepick is... how do you say it? A loan fish?
Loan fish? Oh! You mean Icepick is the name of a loan shark?
Yes. Icepick is an evil man.
You're sure he's the one who killed Ernie?
Ernie was afraid of Icepick. He told me about him this evening.
Hmm. Very curious. I'm surprised you had time to see Ernie tonight.
Why does that surprise you?
Because you've been spending so much time with Mr. Dorian.
Steve? He is attractive, certainly, but we are only friends. Ernie was the man I loved. What will I do without him?
I can see you're upset. I'll leave you alone.
